caption: Central News Photo Service, A Life Saving Appliance to Protect Those Who Like to Skate on Thin Ice (1917), photograph: George Hanlon, foreman of parks for the borough of Queens, with his apparatus for reaching skaters who have fallen through
alt: A black-and-white photograph of three men in caps and long coats standing on a frozen, snow-dusted pond. One holds a long pole angled up over his shoulder; at their feet lie a short ladder and a long wooden beam on a sled-like frame, with a coil of rope. Houses and telegraph poles line the far shore, and a pale sun shows through the haze.
bibliography: Central News Photo Service. A Life Saving Appliance to Protect Those Who Like to Skate on Thin Ice. 1917, photographic print, National Photo Company Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, LOT 12352-3.
title: A Life Saving Appliance to Protect Those Who Like to Skate on Thin Ice
